caption:
One missed train. Two completely different movies. 🎬

I built a tiny movie pitch app with an AI coding assistant. Type an everyday situation, tap a button, and compare two ORIGINAL fictional story worlds: a Bollywood-inspired musical mystery and a Hollywood-inspired night thriller.

Want to build your own? Copy this prompt into an AI coding tool:

“Create a mobile-friendly movie pitch generator using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Add one input for an everyday situation, a ‘Make the movies’ button, and two distinct cards. Each card should display an original title, genre, one-sentence plot, and visual motif. Start with local story templates that work without an API key. Make the button update both cards when the input changes. Use fictional characters and original stories, with no film clips or celebrity likenesses.”

The starter shown here uses transparent local templates; it does not call AI at runtime. Source: github.com/pankajgupta0299/buildwithpankaj-renderer/tree/main/reel06
